# Data Preparation

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggdist)
library(ggside)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)

data_ppt <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealityBending/IllusionGamePhenomenologicalControl/refs/heads/main/data/rawdata_participants.csv")

data_ig <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RealityBending/IllusionGamePhenomenologicalControl/refs/heads/main/data/rawdata_illusion.csv") |>
    mutate(
        Illusion_Effect = ifelse(sign(Illusion_Strength) > 0, "Incongruent", "Congruent"),
        Task_Difficulty = abs(Illusion_Difference),
        Condition_Illusion = case_when(
            Illusion_Effect == "Congruent" ~ "Congruent",
            Illusion_Effect == "Incongruent" & Illusion_Strength <= median(Illusion_Strength[Illusion_Effect == "Incongruent"], na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Mild",
            Illusion_Effect == "Incongruent" & Illusion_Strength > median(Illusion_Strength[Illusion_Effect == "Incongruent"], na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Strong"
        ),
        Condition_Difficulty = datawizard::categorize(
            Task_Difficulty,
            split = "quantile",
            n_groups = 2,
            labels = c("Hard", "Easy")
        ),
        .by = "Illusion_Type"
    )
```

The initial sample consisted of `r report::report_participants(data_ppt, age="Age", gender="Gender", education="Education")`, for a total trial number of `r nrow(data_ig)`.


## Experiment Duration

The experiment's median duration is `r insight::format_value(median(data_ppt$Experiment_Duration))` min (`r insight::format_ci(bayestestR::hdi(data_ppt$Experiment_Duration, ci=0.5))`).

```{r}
data_ppt |>
    mutate(
        Participant = fct_reorder(Participant, Experiment_Duration),
        Category = ifelse(Experiment_Duration > 60, "extra", "ok"),
        Duration = ifelse(Experiment_Duration > 60, 60, Experiment_Duration)
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(y = Participant, x = Duration)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Category, shape = Category)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = median(data_ppt$Experiment_Duration), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("extra" = 3, ok = 19)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("extra" = "red", ok = "black")) +
    guides(color = "none", shape = "none") +
    ggside::geom_xsidedensity(data = filter(data_ppt, Experiment_Duration < 60), aes(x=Experiment_Duration), fill = "grey", color = NA) +
    ggside::scale_xsidey_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
        title = "Experiment Completion Time",
        x = "Duration (in minutes)",
        y = "Participants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggside::theme_ggside_void() +
    theme(
        ggside.panel.scale = .3,
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
```


## Personality Questionnaires Computation

### IPIP6


```{r}
ipip6 <- select(data_ppt, starts_with("ipip_"))
ipip6[grepl("_R", names(ipip6))] <- 8 - ipip6[grepl("_R", names(ipip6))]

data_ppt$IPIP6_Extraversion <- rowMeans(ipip6[grepl("Ext", names(ipip6))])
data_ppt$IPIP6_Conscientiousness <- rowMeans(ipip6[grepl("Cons", names(ipip6))])
data_ppt$IPIP6_Neuroticism <- rowMeans(ipip6[grepl("Neuro", names(ipip6))])
data_ppt$IPIP6_Openness <- rowMeans(ipip6[grepl("Open", names(ipip6))])
data_ppt$IPIP6_HonestyHumility <- rowMeans(ipip6[grepl("HonHum", names(ipip6))])
data_ppt$IPIP6_Agreeableness <- rowMeans(ipip6[grepl("Agr", names(ipip6))])
```

### PID-5

```{r}
pid5 <- select(data_ppt, starts_with("pid_"))

data_ppt$PID5_Disinhibition <- rowMeans(pid5[grepl("Dis", names(pid5))])
data_ppt$PID5_Detachment <- rowMeans(pid5[grepl("Det", names(pid5))])
data_ppt$PID5_NegativeAffect <- rowMeans(pid5[grepl("NegAff", names(pid5))])
data_ppt$PID5_Antagonism <- rowMeans(pid5[grepl("Ant", names(pid5))])
data_ppt$PID5_Psychoticism <- rowMeans(pid5[grepl("Psy", names(pid5))])
```


# Exclusion

## PCS 

```{r}
outliers_pcs1 <- data_ppt[data_ppt$pcs_hello != "Hello", "Participant"]
outliers_pcs2 <- data_ppt[data_ppt$pcs_noballs == TRUE, "Participant"]
outliers_pcs3 <- data_ppt[data_ppt$pcs_press < 5, "Participant"] # get PP count
outliers_pcs <- unique(c(outliers_pcs1, outliers_pcs2))
```

Departing from our preregistered analysis, the main analysis does not apply the third attention check, in which participants had to press the space bar at least 5 times upon seeing the words "PLEASE WAIT" on the screen. This check failed `r length(outliers_pcs3)` (`r insight::format_percent(length(outliers_pcs3) / nrow(data_ppt))`) participants, `r sum(data_ppt$pcs_press == 0)` of whom did not press at all. The space bar task is the behavioural component of PCS item 10 (post-session suggestion), in which participants are told that they will press the space bar six times *and will forget having been told to do so*, so not pressing can reflect a response to the amnesia suggestion rather than inattention (see the analysis report). The fully registered sample, in which this check is applied, is built at the end of this report.

Thus, we only removed `r length(outliers_pcs)` (`r insight::format_percent(length(outliers_pcs) / nrow(data_ppt))`) participants that either did not report hearing "Hello" at the beginning of the experiment, or responded that no balls were presented on the screen.

```{r}
data_ppt$PCS_Outlier_Press <- ifelse(data_ppt$Participant %in% outliers_pcs3, TRUE, FALSE)
data_ppt <- filter(data_ppt, !Participant %in% outliers_pcs)
data_ig <- filter(data_ig, !Participant %in% outliers_pcs)

# Kept for the fully registered sample (see below)
data_ppt_pcs <- data_ppt
data_ig_pcs <- data_ig
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### PCS Exclusions Table

```{r}
pcs_ex_tib <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Participant = outliers_pcs1, Reason = "Failed 'Hello' check"),
  tibble(Participant = outliers_pcs2, Reason = "Reported no balls"),
)

pcs_ex_tib |> 
  knitr::kable(caption = "Exclusions From Phenomenological Control Scale") |> 
  kableExtra::scroll_box(height = "300px") |> 
  kableExtra::kable_styling()
```

### PCS Exclusions Graph

```{r}
pcs_ex_bar <- pcs_ex_tib |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Reason, fill = Reason)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
    labs(
    title = "Exclusions From Phenomenological Control Scale",
    x = "Reason for Exclusion",
    y = "Count",
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")

pcs_ex_bar
```

:::

## Illusion Game Participants

### Error Rate (registered)

We removed participants with an error rate > 45% (suggesting chance-level, i.e., random, responding) for any of the illusion types. Outliers detected in the first block will be discarded entirely (suggesting that they did not properly do the task), but if only the second set is bad, then only the second set will be discarded (suggesting that they got "bored" when having to re-do the task), as the illusion sensitivity can still be estimated, albeit with less precision. 

```{r}
data_error <- data_ig |>
    summarize(
        p_Error = sum(Error) / n(),
        .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Block")
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(p_Error))

outliers_error <- filter(data_error, p_Error > 0.45)
outliers_error_full <- unique(filter(outliers_error, Block == "A")$Participant)
outliers_error_half <- unique(filter(outliers_error, Block == "B")$Participant)
outliers_error_half <- outliers_error_half[!(outliers_error_half %in% outliers_error_full)]

data_error |>
    ggplot(aes(x = p_Error)) +
    geom_density(aes(color = Illusion_Type)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.45, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    facet_wrap(~Block) +
    theme_minimal()
```

Based on error rate, `r length(outliers_error_full)` participants were excluded entirely and `r length(outliers_error_half)` participants had their second block removed.


### Response Time (registered)

Participants whose RTs are significantly slower than the group average (possibly indicative of a different strategy) were also excluded from the analysis (RT > 4 SD above the mean).

```{r}
data_rt <- data_ig |>
    summarize(Mean_RT = mean(RT), .by = "Participant") |>
    mutate(z_RT = as.numeric(standardize(Mean_RT)))

outliers_rt <- filter(data_rt, z_RT > 4)$Participant

data_rt |>
    ggplot(aes(x = z_RT)) +
    geom_density() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 4, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    theme_minimal()
```

Based on RT, `r length(outliers_rt)` participants were excluded entirely (`r sum(outliers_rt %in% outliers_error_full)` of whom were also flagged by the error-rate criterion).

### Sensitivity: block-wise RT rule (unregistered)

```{r}
data_rt_block <- data_ig |>
    summarize(Mean_RT = mean(RT), .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Block")) |>
    mutate(z_RT = as.numeric(standardize(Mean_RT)), .by = c("Illusion_Type", "Block"))

outliers_rtblock_full <- unique(filter(data_rt_block, z_RT > 4, Block == "A")$Participant)
outliers_rtblock_half <- unique(filter(data_rt_block, z_RT > 4, Block == "B")$Participant)
outliers_rtblock_half <- outliers_rtblock_half[!(outliers_rtblock_half %in% outliers_rtblock_full)]

data_ppt$IG_Outlier_RTBlock_Full <- data_ppt$Participant %in% outliers_rtblock_full
data_ppt$IG_Outlier_RTBlock_Half <- data_ppt$Participant %in% outliers_rtblock_half
```

### Apply

```{r}
outliers_full <- unique(c(outliers_error_full, outliers_rt))
outliers_half <- outliers_error_half[!(outliers_error_half %in% outliers_full)]

data_ig <- data_ig |>
    filter(!Participant %in% outliers_full) |>
    filter(!((Block == "B") & (Participant %in% outliers_half)))

data_ppt <- filter(data_ppt, !Participant %in% outliers_full)
data_ig <- filter(data_ig, Participant %in% data_ppt$Participant)
```


::: {.panel-tabset}

### IG Exclusions Table

```{r}
ig_ex_tib <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Participant = outliers_error_full, Reason = "Error rate > 45% (block A)", "Extent of Exclusion" = "Participant-level"),
  tibble(Participant = outliers_error_half, Reason = "Error rate > 45% (block B only)", "Extent of Exclusion" = "Block-level"),
  tibble(Participant = outliers_rt, Reason = "Mean RT > 4 SD", "Extent of Exclusion" = "Participant-level")
)

ig_ex_tib |> 
  knitr::kable(caption = "Exclusions From Illusion Game") |> 
  kableExtra::scroll_box(height = "300px") |>
```

```{r}
ig_ex_bar <- ig_ex_tib |>

  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(

    x = "Extent of Exclusion",
    y = "Count",
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(fill = "none")

ig_ex_bar
```

:::

## Illusion Game Trials

Departing from the registered protocol, individual extreme trials (RT < 0.2 s or > 5 s; Thériault et al., 2024) were flagged to mitigate the risk of confounding effects driven by extreme speed or accuracy strategies. These trials are kept in the saved data (column `RT_Outlier`) and are only removed in the corresponding sensitivity analysis.

```{r}
data_ig$RT_Outlier <- data_ig$RT <= 0.2 | data_ig$RT >= 5
n_before <- nrow(data_ig)
n_removed <- sum(data_ig$RT_Outlier)
```

This flagged `r n_removed` trials (`r round(n_removed / n_before * 100, 2)`% of total; `r sum(data_ig$RT <= 0.2)` faster than 0.2 s and `r sum(data_ig$RT >= 5)` slower than 5 s).

# Fully Registered Sample

This sample applies all registered exclusion criteria, including the space bar check, and no unregistered step (the trial-level RT filter is not applied). The Illusion Game criteria are recomputed on the participants who passed all three PCS checks.

```{r}
ig_reg <- filter(data_ig_pcs, !Participant %in% outliers_pcs3)

err_reg <- ig_reg |>
    summarize(p_Error = sum(Error) / n(), .by = c("Participant", "Illusion_Type", "Block")) |>
    filter(p_Error > 0.45)
reg_full <- unique(filter(err_reg, Block == "A")$Participant)
reg_half <- unique(filter(err_reg, Block == "B")$Participant)

rt_reg <- ig_reg |>
    summarize(Mean_RT = mean(RT), .by = "Participant") |>
    mutate(z_RT = as.numeric(standardize(Mean_RT)))
reg_full <- unique(c(reg_full, filter(rt_reg, z_RT > 4)$Participant))
reg_half <- reg_half[!(reg_half %in% reg_full)]

data_ig_registered <- ig_reg |>
    filter(!Participant %in% reg_full) |>
    filter(!((Block == "B") & (Participant %in% reg_half)))
data_ppt_registered <- filter(data_ppt_pcs, Participant %in% data_ig_registered$Participant)
```

Of the `r length(unique(ig_reg$Participant))` participants who passed all three PCS checks, `r length(reg_full)` were fully excluded and `r length(reg_half)` had their second block removed, leaving `r nrow(data_ppt_registered)` participants (`r nrow(data_ig_registered)` trials).

```{r}

write.csv(data_ppt, "../data/data_participants.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data_ig, "../data/data_illusion.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data_ppt_registered, "../data/data_participants_registered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data_ig_registered, "../data/data_illusion_registered.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
